headline: Four steps. Then your network works for you.

step01.title: Create your card
step01.description: Fill out a short form, pick a design — and your sleek digital business card is ready.

step02.title: Add your contacts
step02.description: Import your existing contacts — from phone, Telegram, LinkedIn, or Google. Naura removes duplicates.

step03.title: Connect
step03.description: Once you're connected on Naura, you never have to fill in or update a contact's details. But your private notes about the person stay right alongside.

step04.title: Build your social capital
step04.description: Now no connection gets lost, and your circle points you to new ones. The full power of networking is in your hands.
